chapter_mission: Talon tells Ben more about Tess, Operation Glasshook, Operation Nightglass, Marael Sen, and the remembered GAG corridor moment: ‘Move her first.’ This is not a lore dump; it is Talon finally letting Ben see where Tess placed him and why that still burns. Tess was Talon’s former mentor and senior commander. During a wartime GAG interdiction mission on Coruscant, Talon disobeyed Tess to save trapped troops and civilians at the cost of the mission. Tess reassigned him out of field duty as punishment and “education,” intending to teach him to see the whole operation. The war collapsed before Tess could bring him back, and Talon’s reassignment became the record that ruined him.
chapter_turn: If Tess is involved, Iresh is not a theory; it is an operation.
